major_findings.finding: The grade-7 18-member NN table cannot remain one canonical 'verb-derived NN exception set'. It mixes modern memorized lexical exceptions, dictionary adjectives, and forms whose NN is explainable by regular participial/derivational structure.

The grade-7 source includes `считанный` in the NN memorization bucket. Current norm distinguishes `считаные минуты/часы` (one Н, adjective meaning 'very few') from a true participle such as `считанные кем-либо предметы` (НН).

The grade-6/10 one-N adjective lists are orthographically useful but morphologically heterogeneous. Current Gramota rules explicitly distinguish non-derived/dictionary adjectives, adjectives formed without suffix -н-, and ordinary -ан-/-ян- cases.

current_authoritative_evidence.finding: Current exception list for NN in this zone includes lexicalized adjectives such as `блаженный, виданный, вожделенный, доморощенный, долгожданный, жданный, желанный, лелеянный, неведанный, невиданный, негаданный, недреманный, нежданный, немедленный, медленный, неслыханный, нечаянный, Первозванный, самонадеянный, священный` and several compound technical formations.
`невиданный`, `неслыханный` and related НЕ-forms are memorized exceptions with NN.
Modern norm: `считаные минуты` with one Н; NN remains in participial use such as `считанные ... стулья`.
`раненый солдат` vs `раненный в ногу/в бою солдат` is a current contextual N/NN boundary; the explanation is tied to the bidirectional/aspectual behavior of `ранить` and dependent words/context.
Stable one-N adjective combinations include `конченый человек`, `названый брат/сестра`, `посажёный отец/мать`, `Прощёное воскресенье`; `смышлёный` is always one Н.

current_authoritative_evidence.source: Gramota.ru Учебник — Н/НН in denominative adjectives + answer 328131
current_authoritative_evidence.finding: One-N difficult adjectives are not one morphological type. The rule separately treats `багряный, зелёный, пряный, румяный, юный`; `свиной, бараний` are formed without suffix -н-.

new_units.canonical_label: НН: современные словарно запоминаемые исключения в зоне отглагольных прилагательных
new_units.notes: This is the intersection of the grade-7 source list with current authoritative memorized-exception guidance. Do not silently expand it to the entire modern list until source/completeness phase.

new_units.canonical_label: НН: словарные прилагательные из 7-классного источника, не сводимые к одному 'исключению из правила'
new_units.notes: Current dictionaries confirm spellings and adjective status for these lexical items. Keep as a dictionary-practice group for now; do not claim the same derivational reason for all four.

new_units.canonical_label: Формы с НН из старой таблицы, которые не должны считаться отдельным lexical-exception denominator unit
new_units.denominator_policy: EXCLUDE_AS_SEPARATE_EXCEPTION_IDENTITIES unless later completeness review finds an independent special boundary
new_units.notes: For example, current dictionaries analyze `обещанный`, `слушанный`, `слышанный` as passive participial forms of the corresponding verbs. Their occurrence in the old memorization table does not justify counting them as lexical exceptions.

new_units.canonical_label: СЧИТАНЫЙ / СЧИТАННЫЙ: прилагательное 'очень немногие' vs причастие
new_units.source_conflict: Grade-7 source bucket gives `считанный` without the modern semantic/context split.
new_units.learner_policy: Never teach `считанные минуты` as current norm.

canonicalization_decisions.member_accounting_note: All 18 old source members are retained either in a current canonical unit or in a non-denominator source-provenance bucket; no member is silently dropped.

new_units.notes: Current dictionary gives adjective `бешеный`; Gramota explains one Н under the ordinary verb-derived adjective rule from imperfective `бесить`, so do not label it a lexical exception in final learner explanation.

canonicalization_decisions.counting_policy: parent organizational; branch/member mastery policy to be decided during denominator materialization, without double-counting parent plus members

critical_source_corrections: `считанные минуты` must be corrected to current `считаные минуты` in any future learner content.
Do not describe all 18 grade-7 NN-table words as one modern class of exceptions.
Do not describe `бешеный` as a lexical exception merely because the old source table groups it with exceptions.
Do not describe all one-N adjectives as one morphological formation type.
